title: Positivity of compact Kähler varieties admitting an int-amplified endomorphism
summary: We study compact Kähler varieties admitting int-amplified endomorphisms from the viewpoint of positivity of tangent sheaves. Our main result shows that the tangent sheaf of such a variety is weakly positively curved; in particular, it is pseudo-effective in a strong sense. This establishes a new link between complex dynamics and the positivity theory of tangent sheaves, and provides an alternative to equivariant MMP techniques in the compact Kähler setting.
